description: Suno Studio effect. Band-limits backing vocals, cuts presence and tilts the tone, then applies a static gain reduction so they sit behind the lead. Apply to the rendered BACKING VOCALS stem inside Suno Studio; this is not a lyric tag.

metadata.description: Suno Studio effect. Band-limits backing vocals, cuts presence and tilts the tone, then applies a static gain reduction so they sit behind the lead.

tuck.description: Static gain reduction in dB so the backing vocals sit behind the lead (not a sidechain duck).
tuck.label: Tuck

hp.description: Highpass corner that pulls the backing vocals out of the lead's low core.
hp.label: HP

lp.description: Lowpass corner that rolls off the top to keep the backing vocals out of the lead's air.
lp.label: LP

presence cut.description: Peaking cut near 3kHz to reduce presence that would compete with the lead.
presence cut.label: Pres Cut

tilt.description: Single tilt control: boosts lows and cuts highs (or the reverse when negative) near 250Hz / 5kHz.
tilt.label: Tilt

dry/wet mix.description: Blend between dry input and processed signal.
dry/wet mix.label: Mix

bypass.description: Pass the dry signal through unprocessed.
bypass.label: Bypass
